A real auth failure reopens the temporary operation block while shutdown remains closed. Public player requests hold the transition gate for their full call and verify epoch; status/room/match supervisors are drained independently. CommunityNode heartbeat remains independent during player transitions, while its owned-account sync runs outside the tick lock only under a non-blocking auth-transition gate with before/after blocked, shutdown, and epoch checks.
